pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Visible patches are medium-brown with predominantly polygonal and sharp-edged geometry. Patch size is smaller and more irregular near the neck and shoulder, transitioning to larger, more defined polygons on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-cream negative space forms a continuous network of interconnected pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent. The thickness of these pathways appears relatively uniform across the shoulder and upper flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck is visible as a dark, short-pile fringe. The silhouette against the background displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged edge.
